metadata.description: Turn a static site into a real WordPress theme — pixel-identical, and still editable. Beta.

plugins.name: html2wp
plugins.description: BETA. Convert a static HTML site into a standalone WordPress block theme, verified against the original at three viewport widths — and reviewed by you before handover. The conversion runs through a verified Astro 5 build, so the Astro project is a real output too — proven pixel-identical to the source before anything WordPress-shaped is generated.
